services.name: Day Sail
services.desc: The ultimate way to enjoy the surrounding beauty of Martha’s Vineyard is to sail onboard the Schooner Alabama. 2 Hours About the Trip Scheduled regularly throughout the season, the Alabama sets sail from the Black Dog Wharf on three-hour long cruises. Join us onboard for an unforgettable afternoon or evening sail, where as a passenger you join the crew in the raising of the sails, manning the wheel with the captain or simply sitting back, enjoying the gorgeous scenery as you sip a glass of wine. A sail onboard will be the highlight of your stay on the island. This is a true sailing 3 Hours • All Ages • Fills Fast, Book Now!

services.name: Fireworks Cruise / Edgartown, July 4th
services.desc: The most sought after cruise of the season. See the fireworks in Edgartown aboard the Alabama. Guests are shuttled out to the schooner on a harbor launch @6pm and treated to a sail in Edgartown harbor and front row tickets to the fireworks while anchored near the lighthouse. Guests return immediately following fireworks @ 10pm 4 4 Hours • All Ages

services.name: Fireworks Cruise / Oak Bluffs, August 21st
services.desc: The Oak Bluff’s Fireworks Cruise aboard the schooner Alabama is an experience not to be missed. Board the schooner in Vineyard Haven and enjoy a sunset sail aboard the Alabama as she transits from her mooring to the fireworks venue off of Oak Bluff’s village. After the sunset sail the Alabama will anchor in close proximity to the fireworks so that guests are treated to a fantastic vantage point. The schooner will be returning to her mooring immediately following the event where guests will disembark at the same location that they boarded – at The Black Dog Wharf. Guests are encouraged All Ages • Starts at 6 pm • 3 - 4 Hours

quotes.author: Janet • TripAdvisor
quotes.text: had a great outing on the Alabama with our family. it was rather windy but the crew handled it well — beautiful trip. we did byo which worked ni key. enjoyed nice conversations with the crew and with other guests. Recommend!

quotes.author: Nicole D. • TripAdvisor
quotes.text: My family had a wonderful time on the Alabama! The Captain and crew were so hospitable. We all helped hoist the sails and then enjoyed a beautiful relaxing sail. Do this while on the Vineyard, you won’t be disappointed!!

quotes.author: adiverdiehl • TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Such a treat to get out on the Sound on a beautifully crafted Tall Ship for a fresh perspective of this special island! Knowledgeable & friendly crew engaged guests to the extent guests could choose.

quotes.author: Robert J. • TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Really awesome sail with a super cool captain and crew! The Alabama has a ton of character and she really made it an enjoyable experience :) Have a chowder at the inn with a beer and set sail!!!!!

quotes.author: Peter W • TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Spent a great afternoon on the water with Capt. Douglas and the crew- highly recommend! Can’t believe it took us this long to take advantage of this local gem!
